scene: Inside the rumbling crawler, mechanical pigeons deliver warm tea to passengers.
beats: The fragrant cinnamon tea warms you thoroughly. Gears grind to a halt at Gear Bridge, and the doors slide open to the bustling walkway.
The blinking bulbs reveal a hidden bypass under the turning cogs. With a hearty clang, the crawler docks at Gear Bridge, its heavy doors parting.
You peek inside to find three sleeping miniature grease-monkeys curled like donuts. With a pneumatic hiss, the doors slide wide at Gear Bridge.
picture: Inside the side-scrolling crawler cabin, a level floor runs left to right. On the far left, a mechanical brass pigeon offers tea. The player in orange jacket and beanie stands left of centre. Up high, a glowing mechanical route map clicks. On the right, a rattling wicker basket sits on a green bench.
shown: a tiny clockwork pigeon holding a steaming ceramic cup on the left
an illuminated brass route board clicking above the aisle up high
a tied wicker basket rattling on an empty seat on the right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the crawler rattles past the stop, humming to a distant horn. At the terminal, you hop a tow truck bound for the glowing hum of Neon Sign Hospital.
after.then: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital
